_comment: Plugin Template - Copy this to create new plugins
_usage: Duplicate this file to plugins/<your-plugin>/plugin.json and customize
name: my-plugin
author: Your name

beforePrompt: Additional context or guidance to inject before the agent processes the user prompt
afterTurn: Actions to perform after each agent turn (e.g., run tests, commit changes)
onResume: State to reapply when resuming a session
beforePersist: Custom state to save before session persistence
beforeDelegate: Guidance to inject before delegating to a subagent
afterDelegate: Processing to apply after a subagent completes

toolAliases._description: Map custom tool names to base tools

virtualTools._description: Define mock tools with response templates

scripts._description: Helper scripts to run at lifecycle points
